summary: Ford Motor Credit Co. LLC filed an 8-K disclosing the issuance and sale of $1 billion aggregate principal amount of 6.467% Notes due 2036 under its existing shelf registration statement. This is a routine debt offering, not a special situation. No terms beyond the principal and interest rate are specified; there is no premium, board recommendation, or advisor. The notes were issued pursuant to a medium-term note program. Watch for future debt management actions, but no event-driven angle applies.
